reviews.comment: She makes this class super easy. Each week you have a PackBack and quizzes based on the textbook. I didn't read the textbook and still did well on these, they are super easy and should only take a couple hours each week (I typically completed them during lecture). Attendance is graded but I stopped showing up since my grade was high enough.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Class was super easy, the lectures were sometimes boring and repetitive but occasionally she would throw in some interesting comments that made the lectures fun to listen to. Since she takes attendance and it's about 10% of the grade, just show up to class. Like every other class the packbacks get annoying but not difficult. Overall good prof.

I won't bore you with any complex reviews. If you have half a brain, and want an easy A or A+ take this class. Only mildly annoying thing is she takes attendance as part of her grading criteria. But if you show up to class (don't even pay attention or take any notes), I don't see how you don't earn an A or at least a B+.

Judging by the other reviews this might have just been a bad class for her. Professor Vickers was funny, nice, and seemed to like what she was teaching. My main complaint is the grading. Turnaround was very slow, the grading incredibly harsh, and the feedback was vague. I was not the only one with this issue.

If you need to take SOCI 420, PLEASE register for Dr. Vickers' course if you can. This is one of the hardest courses on the SOCI decree plan, but she designs the course very well and lectures very clearly. If you attend class and pay attention then you will secure yourself an A. And go to her office hours!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Possibly the easiest class I have taken. There are no essays unless you do the extra credit at the end. She takes attendance, but the lectures aren't important. Weekly knowledge checks, quiz, and a packback (all super easy). All the tests are online open note/internet. She's super liberal, but as long as you can ignore that, the easy A is worth it.

The class is super easy. I do other assignments during the class and I still have an A. The class assignments are super easy, and the tests were also pretty easy. The lectures are a little boring to listen to, but no big deal.

If yall dont take her idk what youre doing. Everything is online and most assignments are completion. Her tests are online, two days long, open book and open note. She frequently ends class early or cancels class. Lecture may be a bit boring but I enjoyed listening to what she had to say. Very sweet Prof. TAKE HER, I REPEAT TAKE HER.

Even though it was her first time teaching SOCI420, I think she did amazing. She was clear and loud when teaching the class, so she's not like any other boring professors out there. She's very understanding and gives extra credit. She gave students a chance to turn in their assignments after the deadlines which was pretty nice. TAKE HER if you can.

This class isn't the most interesting, at first it was easier to focus in classes but it more was just showing up to take attendance. I honestly ended up going to class to just sit there completing the assignments due for that week. Assignments were easy to complete and she is very understand when life happens.

Ok, to be honest this is not the most exciting class in the world, but it's an easy A if you put in not that much effort. On paper, there's a lot of assignments, but they're all pretty quick and everything is open note. Definately recommend if you need this class as a prerequisite or core curriculum.
This is literally the easiest class ever. Chapter quizzes, packbacks, and open note exams (use the textbook). Lectures are pretty boring but just show up for the attendance credit!

Vickers makes the material as understandable as possible. She cares about your success in the class, is a fair grader, and offers extra credit as well. It was not my first time attempting this course, and I can say with full certainty that if you have to take this class, TAKE IT WITH HER. Attend class, do the assignments, and you will pass 100%.

Easy class if you need your CORE credit. The assignments and quizzes are designed for you to make a 100 or a high grade. Tests are open-book, and the packback discussions are not hard at all, they're due bi-weekly. You barely have to take notes in this class, if any, and you only show up once a week for attendance.

Take this class!!! Its very easy, all you have to do is go to lectures once a week, the other day is online so it is a blended class. She does attendance at the end of class which counts for your grade. There is homework, mainly graded for completion, few quizzes that are all due at exam time. Exams are on canvas, open note, open for several days.

She is an amazing professor. We met once a week in person and once online. Although the online lectures were slightly boring, this course was still enjoyable. An easy A for sure, as long as you do the SAGE vantage assignments. The exams are online on Canvas and are open note. She is very caring and wants you to succeed.

Easy homework and lectures. All you have to do is take notes in class from her slides since she doesn't provide them and keep up with packbacks. She uses a SAGE book but I never had to read it I just used it for homework. Super sweet and always willing to extend a deadline for you.

She makes you purchase SAGE Vantage and Packback which totals to ~$40. 3 exams + assignments due every Sunday night but takes like an hour to do. Attendance is 4% of your grade. Fairly easy A if you study for exams the night before. Super liberal but understand there's another side to everything so her views didn't bother me too much.
